ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (>90% black) with sparse, high-contrast white focal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips; left distal tip exhibits anomalous jagged truncation compared to right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Asymmetrical jagged truncation of the left distal tip; widespread circular depigmented scarring across the ventral surface.
